errors.quote: dividing every cost by $V=Tp=\Theta(n)$, the number of stored bits, where $T$ counts coefficients and $p$, of order $\lg n$, is the precision in bits of each
errors.problem: V=Tp is not the number of stored bits. The paper (Section 'The complete time bound', lines 4810-4812) puts V=Tp and says the fixed-width coefficient formats use Theta(p) bits per coefficient, so a full padded array has Theta(V) stored bits. V is proportional to the stored volume, not equal to it. The normalization and the bound are unaffected.
